title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - Dedicated Q2 priorities & Console rollout
body:
Goal for this 1:1:
- Align on Q2 priorities across Hosted API/Console/Dedicated/Private.
- Clear engineering capacity constraints and trade-offs (latency vs cost).
- Decide on canary plan for Console rollout for the Dedicated customers pilot.

Quick context / notes to self:
- Finance wants committed numbers by Feb 28 for Dedicated offer tiers (S/M/L). We need realistic throughput SLOs tied to those tiers.
- Recent infra perf run (perf-run-2025-01) showed 20% regression at seq_len=2048 with current kernel set - likely impacts Dedicated baseline.
- Console: rollout UI toggles + per-route throttling feature should be behind feature flag; UX team wants signal by 2/20 on API for toggles.

Agenda:
1) Status updates (2-3 min)
   - Quick: what shipped since last 1:1 (A: batching config UI mock landed; infra fixed mem leak on transformer-serve)
2) Metrics where we care (5 min)
   - Hosted API p95 token latency: 180ms (target 150) - regression at long sequences
   - Dedicated baseline throughput per GPU (fp16 + kv-cache): 600 tokens/s (target 750)
   - Error budget burn: 1.6% this week (SLO 0.5%) - mostly transient network flaps in us-west2
3) Dedicated Q2 commits (10 min)
   - Need decision: target throughput tiers for S/M/L and what hardware assumption (A100 vs H100).
   - Trade-offs: increase price or reduce SLO; ops prefers predictable quotas.
   - Ask: can we get reliable benchmark numbers by 2/21? If not, propose fallback plan (conservative tiers + credit buffer).
4) Console rollout plan for per-route controls (8 min)
   - Canary plan: customers list for pilot (3 customers identified) - need engineering to add routing config endpoints + audit logs.
   - Feature flag gating + telemetry hooks: ensure we capture cost delta and latency at token-level.
   - UX wants toggle API stable by 2/20, engineering estimate says 2w dev + 1w ops testing - mismatch.
5) Private deployment pilot (5 min)
   - Customer X onboarding: they want KMS integration + longer retention for logs. Ensure SRE can support air-gapped deploy.
6) Blockers / help needed (5 min)
   - Kernel regression: request eng-serving-runtime to prioritize kernel backport or fallback path. Owner: Samir.
   - Benchmark infra flakes in perf lab: need a dedicated run slot next week (request from release-eng).

Notes / talking points to bring up:
- Emphasize customer impact: some Dedicated trial customers saw 2x cost on peak due to lack of batching config in UI. We should prioritize a quick fix in Console to expose batching_cold_start param.
- Rollouts: propose a new canary metric (tokens_per_sec_delta) to track per-tenant perf change after model/quant changes.
- For Private: make sure entitlements + license checks are part of install script; avoids last-minute legal loops.

Follow-ups / Action items (owner - due):
- Samir Kapoor - reproduce kernel perf regression and propose short-term fallback (2/17)
- Elena Rodriguez - finalize Dedicated tier proposals + pricing sensitivity doc, share with finance (2/24)
- Avery Thompson - update Console feature flag contract for per-route controls and send to UX (2/19)
- Release Eng (assign to Taylor) - reserve perf lab slot for benchmark runs w/ H100 on 2/20-2/21 (2/14 to confirm)
- Noah Kim (me) - draft customer comms for Dedicated pilot expectations and share with CS (2/21)

Open questions / TODOs to capture later:
- If benchmarks still lag, do we offer credits or temporarily limit burst capacity for some tiers? Need product decision.
- Do we expose a simplified cost estimator in Console for Dedicated customers? Quick MVP could be per-route token-rate * model-cost lookup.

Prep checklist for meeting:
- Bring latest perf logs (perf-run-2025-01) + link to Jupyter graphs.
- Bring pricing sensitivity spreadsheet (sheet id: finance/dedicated-q2-ps).
- Have 2 quick slides ready: current perf vs target, proposed tier definitions.

Notes-to-self after meeting (placeholder to fill):
- Capture any agreed trade-offs: if we accept lower SLO for S-tier, note rollback conditions.
- Update linked artifacts with any new Jira tickets created.

Rough script / opening lines:
- "Quick update - we shipped the batching UI mock, infra fixed the mem leak; biggest open risk is the kernel perf regression which affects our Dedicated baseline. I want to confirm if we can still commit to tiers or if we need to adjust pricing/expectations. Also need an alignment on Console rollout timing because Ops needs time to validate telemetry"

Misc scratch:
- Potential quick hack: expose a \"burst_limiter\" in Console that caps per-tenant token-rate for first 30 minutes after model switch. Low-cost, could mitigate spikes.
- Slack refs: #prod-api, thread \"perf-regression-02-2025\"

End of doc.
